solverDefinition: A brute-force trial division algorithm for prime factorization. This solver iteratively tests divisibility starting from the smallest prime (2) and continues dividing the number by each prime factor found until the number is fully factored. The algorithm runs in O(√n) time complexity in the worst case, making it suitable for small to moderate-sized integers.
source: Pisano, Leonardo (1202), Incipit liber Abbaci compositus to Lionardo filio Bonaccii Pisano in year Mccij, Museo Galileo.

timeComplexity.Description: in the value of n (exponential in n's bit-length)
